prompts.history-scenes.png:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one original landscape website illustration sheet, 16:9 aspect ratio, ideally 2048 x 1152 pixels.
Primary request: four very simple conceptual Japanese coastal-history vignettes in an EXACT regular 2 x 2 arrangement. The full canvas is divided invisibly into equal quadrants; each quadrant itself is a 16:9 illustration window. No drawn panel boundaries. All four scenes must be centered independently in their own quadrants, with generous completely empty cream margins at outer edges and around both center seams, so later HTML cropping into four equal windows cuts no part of a figure or object. No scene may cross a center seam.
Top-left quadrant: a small coastal shrine gate, one anonymous adult traveler paused with palms together in quiet prayer, a few simple sea waves and wind strokes. A conceptual evocation of ancient mythology and the Chuai / Jingu / Sumiyoshi tradition, never a portrait or literal deity.
Top-right quadrant: two very simple medieval wooden sailing boats separated by one sea wave, a few small anonymous adult figures, a respectful peaceful symbolic memory of Genpei / Dannoura. No combat, blood, weapons, victory gestures, or modern ship.
Bottom-left quadrant: one anonymous late-Edo traveler in simple period-inspired Japanese clothes holding a blank sealed letter beside a temple gate and an unpainted cream earthen wall, evoking Chofu / Bakumatsu. No historical-person likeness or weapons.
Bottom-right quadrant: two anonymous late-19th-century adult envoys of equal size and visual prominence calmly examining blank papers at a plain table, evoking peace negotiations at Shimonoseki. No caricature, flags, victory symbols, or recognizable person.
Style/medium: extremely simple warm naive zine / notebook hand-drawing, broad uncomplicated shapes, slightly uneven thick black marker outlines, awkward friendly dot-eye people, flat ink fills, the gentle clarity of a handmade family illustration. Minimal detail and generous blank paper.
Color palette: ONLY cream paper #F7F4EE, black ink #111111, and one flat SkyBlue pastel #82D6F7. No other colors, even for skin or wood. Cream is also the skin and sail color.
Constraints: brand-new standalone original conceptual vignettes; not historical reconstructions, not data, not a map. No text, letters, written characters, numbers, captions, signs, logos, watermarks, arrows, frames, dividing lines, speech bubbles, UI, photographic texture, 3D, lighting effects, shadows, gradients, or fine decorative clutter.
prompts.local-work-scene.png:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one original landscape website illustration, 16:9 aspect ratio, ideally 2048 x 1152 pixels.
Primary request: one friendly shared workplace street-and-small-kitchen scene, showing local people as paid professionals through ordinary work. A chef at a small open counter receives a crate containing a few simple vegetables and a fish from a local supplier. Beside them, a theatre performer holds a completely blank script; a driver stands near a simple small shuttle; and a young adult craftsperson wearing an apron holds one uncomplicated hand tool. Five large clear adult figures in total, connected by everyday activity and attention to one another as a community. A proposal illustration of enjoyable visitor experiences supporting local work.
Composition: one cohesive simple scene, no separate panels, no diagram. Few large figures and minimal props. Cream whitespace, generous outer margins, no clutter. Keep all figures readable at small website display sizes.
Style/medium: extremely simple warm naive zine / notebook hand-drawing, broad uncomplicated shapes, slightly uneven thick black marker outlines, awkward friendly dot-eye people, flat black ink fills, warm handmade simplicity.
Color palette: ONLY cream paper #F7F4EE, black ink #111111, and one flat MintGreen pastel #B7D98B. No other colors, even for skin, food, vehicle, or wood.
Constraints: brand-new original, a community proposal rather than measured results. No arrows, coins, money, numbers, guarantees, written characters, text, labels, captions, logos, vehicle lettering, watermarks, speech bubbles, frames, UI, photography, 3D, shadows, gradients, fine decorative detail, or complex background.
prompts.theatre-scene.png:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one original landscape website illustration, 16:9 aspect ratio, ideally 2048 x 1152 pixels.
Primary request: a gentle participatory indoor theatre scene. A modern young adult visitor stands holding a completely blank letter or envelope and speaks to a storyteller actor in simple period-inspired Japanese attire. Three audience visitors on stools visibly respond with friendly attentive gestures, one lightly raises a hand to choose a role. Make the action clearly about joining a live story. A very simple cloth backdrop has only a tiny sea-wave motif. The visitor and storyteller face each other naturally; audience visitors share the same scene.
Composition: broad uncomplicated shapes, scene occupies about the central 75% of the canvas width; ample empty cream margins on every side. Full figures and objects remain within the canvas. One coherent indoor theatre scene, not multiple panels.
Style/medium: extremely simple warm naive zine / notebook hand-drawing, slightly uneven thick black marker outlines, awkward friendly dot-eye adult people, flat ink fills. Keep the handmade quality and very low detail level; large readable poses and props.
Color palette: ONLY cream paper #F7F4EE, black ink #111111, and one flat Lavender pastel #C5A6E8. No other colors; cream also serves as skin and blank paper.
Constraints: new original conceptual scene, friendly and attentive, recognizable visitor participation rather than a cinema. No screen, projection, cinema seats, written characters, signs, text, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, speech bubbles, arrows, frames, UI, photography, 3D, shadows, gradients, or detailed decorative clutter.
